newsitem.title: USA: Wild Oats Markets president steps down.
newsitem.headline: Wild Oats Markets president steps down.

text.p: U.S. natural foods retailer Wild Oats Markets Inc said that S.M. "Hass" Hassan resigned as company president effective February 4.
Jim Lee, Wild Oats current chief operating officer, will fill the position on a permanent basis, the company said.
Hassan has served as president since Wild Oats acquired Alfalfa's in July 1996 and was previously the chairman, CEO and co-founder of Alfalfa's Inc, a statement from Wild Oats said.
After twenty years in the natural foods business, Hassan said he's ready to pursue new opportunities.
Wild Oats Market is the second largest natural foods supermarket chain in North America.
